policy: A declared command or a successful preflight is not a benchmark result. EXECUTED requires raw trajectory, evaluator output, command, environment, and hashes.

swebench-lite-agent-smoke.agent: the official SWE-bench infer command backed by mini-SWE-agent
swebench-lite-agent-smoke.model: provided at execution time and recorded verbatim in evidence; no floating default

commands.environment_sanity: uv run swebench eval lite --gold -i sympy__sympy-20590 --run-id gold-${RUN_ID}
commands.agent_inference: uv run swebench infer lite -m ${MODEL_NAME} -r agent-${RUN_ID} -w 1 -- --filter '^sympy__sympy-20590$'
commands.official_evaluation: uv run swebench eval lite -p logs/inference/agent-${RUN_ID}/preds.json -i sympy__sympy-20590 --run-id eval-${RUN_ID} -j 1

required_evidence: exact harness commit and dependency lock
official report.json, test_output.txt, run_instance.log, eval.sh and patch.diff
Docker server version and evaluated image identity
swebench-lite-agent-smoke.claim_ceiling: The repository contains an executable pinned contract only; it contains no SWE-bench score until the required evidence is committed.

webarena-official-agent-smoke.model: provided at execution time and recorded verbatim in evidence; no floating default
required_evidence: exact harness commit and dependency inventory
self-hosted site image identities and reset log
generated config and authenticated browser setup result
full action/observation trajectory and evaluator output
webarena-official-agent-smoke.claim_ceiling: The repository contains an executable pinned contract only; it contains no WebArena success rate until a self-hosted site stack is reset and the required evidence is committed.
